title: Agent: Steelers to add CB Dean on $36.75M deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Agent: Steelers to add CB Dean on $36.75M deal
sources.description: The Steelers have agreed to a three-year, $36.75 million deal with former Buccaneers cornerback Jamel Dean, agent Erik Burkhardt of Roc Nation Sports told ESPN.
